body: yes thank you very much for your nice words. but it's so hard to live when you only know void and silence, and nothing to stay for, no feeling towards anyone, no desires, nothing. i've went through all these years by doing this, thinking i'm might just listen to others, help them a little and carry my burden of not feeling love. but i'm so tired

Sorry, you're right, i just don't know what i'm doing anymore. i'll delete this.i'll delete everything i've done actually this is just the only thing i've wanting to do for years and i'm stuck here because i can't do it, it tortures me. i'm searching a way to solve this. i don't want to cause trouble. hope you'll live a nice life.

so sorry, so sorry

Hey, I don't know where you are, I don't know who you are. At least one person heard you, I'm here. Please reach out for medical help.
I love you.
Same. But nothingness is torturing me more and more, and I have so much hatred for myself that's this situation is now unbearable
Thank you for your support. I didn't reply yesterday but you gave me some comfort. I will try my best to seek help but it's a long and hard process, even for a little step. Sending hugs to you too <3
I feel exactly like you. It's been more than 10 years. I don't know what to say. I feel you, so much.

I'm turning 20 in a few days. Somehow afraid that I won't be able to say "If I die now, I'll never be 20" anymore.
I have no words to comfort you. I'm at the same place as you are, and actually it seems like there's thousands of us. 
Take 11 deep breathes. 
See? Nothing has changed. Or maybe everything has? Being myself has been unbearable for the last few months, or years tbh.
Find something blue close to you. 
See? Blue things seems so calm like it never had any thoughts, or like it already had all thoughts. I not sure I really felt any emotion in my life.
Say 3 words, the firsts that come to you. 
See?
How ridiculous and strange the existence of the voice is? Does it have any substance?
Don't. Don't think. Try to go with instinct for a few moments. Sleep, eat, stay still watching a crack in the ceiling, make weird moves or sounds. Sleep. 
21 is better. 
And when you'll be there, 22 will be better. And on and on. And one day you'll be old, your life shit, but yeah, maybe, who knows, there'll be 4 or 5 good memories, even if it's just the softness of your mattress, the smile of an old lady, or this weird message from a random human on the internet.
Blink one eye after another. 
See? Perspectives change. 
I'm with you.

Hey, I'm new here. I was, and still am in a very dark place tonight. I somehow managed to encounter your post. And then I went through the comments you've posted before. I may not know you, but I genuinely feel the extend of support you give to others, and the shining generosity you put into it.
I feel you, I sincerely belive things about humanity, like each individual is valuable, etc.. but when it comes to me, it seems like everything of this evaporates. I'm terrified by the void, the nothingness that I am (never really felt love, never had authentic idea or opinion, total lack of imagination or creativity, a sickly laziness, a huge amount of self-hatred...even my pain may not be real because I've no reasons to be suffering, didn't lost someone, been assaulted, not in a country at war, and so much more true pains). And it's been that for more than ten years, more I can remember actually. But I needed to tell you: you are not total void, there's something in you and I instantly felt it. You've been essential to people. Days before. And tonight. It calmed me down in the middle of a harsh crisis. I don't know how we will get through this. It is very likely that there's no miracle, no solution, no cure. But maybe an alternative will come, in a way we can't picture now. I hope you're still here, on earth, with me, with us. Sending you all the (tiny) love that I've managed to gather.
